groups.definition: Conversion or stock settlement of convertible debt and preferred securities, and related hedging activity, may dilute existing shareholders and depress the common stock price.
Hedging transactions by option counterparties tied to convertible notes may buy or sell stock or derivatives, affecting the company's share price.
Obligations to repay or repurchase convertible notes in cash, including upon holder put rights, may strain liquidity if refinancing is unavailable.
